Open Graph tags ensure professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and other platforms—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial mention and pricing removes friction and sets expectations before the click.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clearly positions it as a trade and business assistant, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while emphasizing the low-friction entry point of three free searches with no payment commitment. This reduces hesitation and encourages trial engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's full capabilities—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing and save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the user journey—the paywall after the free trial. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing the value and low entry cost, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, helping convert trial users into paying members.
